head: e0d72d80

result.note: after fixing the endpoint retirement observation

failures.test: mqtt.bridge.outbound_tests.test.outbound bridge does not extend expiry across target reconnect
failures.summary: A black-hole target CONNACK wait is not pausable, so the source keepalive lapses and the broker retires the source transport.

notes: The QUIC endpoint retirement failure is fixed: the replies loop's visitor now records RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID, so a client that coalesces retirement with its reply packet is counted. 14 consecutive isolated runs and the full QUIC filter (1156/1156) pass. The MQTT outbound-bridge expiry case remains the only known failure.
